t: DEWALT Ergo 12" (302mm) straight aviation snips feature a reduced handle span, optimising leverage for less effort when cutting tough materials like sheet metal (18-22 gauge), aluminium, copper, leather and vinyl siding. Blades are constructed from durable cold-forged chrome vanadium steel, equipped with a serrated cutting edge to prevent material slippage during use, ensuring a clean and accurate finish. A slip-resistant, bi-material cushion grip provides a firm, comfortable hold to enable prolonged operation. Ideal cutting tool for professional use in various trade applications.
